messages:
deepa rao: FYI — customer INC-5342 says console charts show 0 requests for EU when they select region=eu + model=gpt-redwood-1 + version=v2. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshots/INC-5342/eu-zero.png

anna kim: ugh, thanks. Can you paste exact repro steps and the API/console query they used?

support-bot: Ticket INC-5342 created and linked to this thread. Assigned: support-squad.

deepa rao: Steps from customer: 1) Open Console > Analytics > Requests. 2) Add filters: Region = EU, Model = gpt-redwood-1, Version = v2. 3) Time range = last 24h. Chart becomes empty. If they remove Version filter, counts reappear.

ryan s: Can you run the metrics API call the console makes? e.g. `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/metrics/requests?region=eu&model=gpt-redwood-1&version=v2&window=24h"` — what does it return?

deepa rao: Customer ran that: returned `200` but `{"buckets":[]}`. They attached the raw response.

mike chen: quick glance at metrics-consumer logs for that window — I see the pipeline does an alias normalization step that maps model aliases to canonical model keys. Example log: `[metrics-consumer] INFO applied_alias_normalization model_alias=gpt-redwood-1 -> model_key=gpt-redwood`. Looks like the aggregation is grouping by `model_key` but the console filter includes `version`, and that version is currently attached to the original alias. If normalization drops the alias-specific version tag, the `WHERE` clause ends up matching nothing.

anna kim: hmm. So filter flow: console sends (model alias + version) -> consumer normalizes alias to base model -> aggregation groups by base model AND expects version column to exist -> mismatch -> empty buckets.

ryan s: Can you repro locally? If we can reproduce, we should add `version` to the post-normalization tagset (or carry version through normalization) as a fix. Otherwise short-term: console can fall back to filtering by model alias instead of normalized key.

mike chen: I can reproduce with a small script. Minimal repro: `POST https://ingest.redwood.ai/events` with body `{ "model": "gpt-redwood-1", "version": "v2", "region": "eu", "tokens": 10 }` then run the metrics query. After normalization the record is stored as `model_key=gpt-redwood` and `version=\"\"` — that's the bug.

mike chen: Proposed fix: change normalization to set `version` on the normalized record (carry over incoming version) and update grouping keys. I’ll push a canary patch to metrics-consumer.

deepa rao: Customer is on a paid plan and is seeing billing impact. They want ETA and a workaround.

mike chen: Workaround for now: ask them to filter by model alias only (leave out Version), or use the raw metrics API with `alias=true` param: `?alias=true` — that will match pre-normalization keys. I can enable that param for them temporarily.

anna kim: Preferred medium-term fix is to preserve `version` during normalization. Also need a regression test that validates alias+version queries return results.

ryan s: tagging eng-infra @mike chen — can you also check if this affects Dedicated/private deployments with on-prem normalization configs? Might be a config drift.

mike chen: will do. Pushing canary now — ETA 15m.

sre-bot: Deploy started by mike. Canary: metrics-consumer:canary-2026-03-17-01

mike chen: Canary done. Verified with the same repro payload — console charts return counts again for EU+model+version. Rolling to prod in 30m unless we see anomalies.

deepa rao: I told the customer we have a canary and will rollout. They asked for a changelog note and for us to re-run their historical backfill to repopulate charts if needed.

anna kim: note for follow-up: add an alert on `metrics_consumer.normalization.version_missing` and add an e2e test that sends alias+version and queries via console.

support-bot: INC-5342 updated: Canopy patch applied to metrics-consumer; customer notified; follow-up tasks created (backfill, e2e test, alert).

ryan s: great work. Reopen if the customer still sees gaps after full rollout. :thumbsup:

mike chen: deploying prod now. Will post when finished.

mike chen: prod rollout complete. Confirmed historical backfill kickoff started (job id backfill-17912).

deepa rao: customer confirmed charts restored. Closing INC-5342 after final validation. Thanks everyone. :tada:
